headline: 1911 GOLD HITS 14.86 g/t OVER 7.2m IN 30-HOLE TRUE NORTH INFILL PROGRAM — RESOURCE UPDATE Q4 2026
snippet: 1911 Gold (TSXV: AUMB) released results from 30 underground infill holes totalling 6,483m at its True North gold project in Manitoba, with the headline intercept hitting 14.86 g/t gold over 7.20 metres on the V-1020 Vein. Preliminary results confirm resource continuity needed to support a production restart; an updated resource estimate is targeted for Q4 2026.

headline: MAJOR DRILLING BUYS BUNBURY FOR A$70M — MDI STOCK SURGES 7% AS DRILL CONTRACTOR EXPANDS INTO AUSTRALIA DEWATERING
snippet: Major Drilling (TSX: MDI) agreed to acquire Bunbury Drilling Company, a Western Australia mine dewatering specialist, for A$50 million upfront plus up to A$20 million in earnouts over three years tied to EBITDA targets. Bunbury generated approximately A$43M revenue and A$15M adjusted EBITDA in the trailing twelve months ending June 2026; MDI shares rose 7.21% on the news.

headline: AMERICAN LITHIUM BOOSTS MACUSANI M+I URANIUM RESOURCE 10% TO 57M LB — UPDATED AT $100/LB PRICING ASSUMPTION
snippet: American Lithium Corp (TSXV: LI) released an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for its Macusani Uranium Project in southeastern Peru, lifting M+I resources to approximately 57.16 million lb U3O8 across 121.9 million tonnes — a 10% increase over the prior estimate — using a $100/lb uranium price assumption, double the $50/lb assumption from the historical model. An updated PEA using current pricing and development costs is underway.

headline: FORTUNA DRILLING HITS 1.9 g/t AU OVER 64m AT KABEWEST SENEGAL — 600M STRIKE OPEN, INITIAL RESOURCE TARGET Q1 2027
snippet: Fortuna Mining (TSX: FVI) reported the first drill results from its Kabewest prospect at the Bambadji Project in Senegal: hole FBRC0008 returned 1.9 g/t gold over an estimated 64m true width from 19m, with FBDD0008 adding 3.2 g/t over 24m from surface. Mineralization spans more than 600m of strike and remains open; approximately 70% of assays from the 45-hole, 10,524m campaign are received, with an initial Inferred resource estimate targeted for Q1 2027.

headline: FORTUNA ADVANCES DIAMBA SUD GOLD PERMITTING IN SENEGAL — TWO WEST AFRICA MILESTONES IN ONE TRADING DAY
snippet: On the same day it released Kabewest drill results, Fortuna Mining announced progress on permitting for its Diamba Sud gold project, also in Senegal, reinforcing the company's West Africa strategy. Senegal has emerged as an increasingly active jurisdiction for junior and mid-tier gold exploration as the Bambadji district gains geological recognition.

headline: BEARISH CASE: GOLD, SILVER MAY EXTEND LOSSES AS US VOTE AND PAYROLLS CREATE A DOUBLE MACRO HURDLE THIS WEEK
snippet: A Monday analysis argues the consensus view that gold will rally post-election may be premature: the precious metals are now facing a sequential macro challenge — midterm uncertainty Tuesday followed by the November 6 payrolls print — that could extend October's losses rather than reverse them, particularly if the labour market surprises to the upside and reinforces December rate-hike pricing.

headline: RBA HIKES TO 4.85% — HIGHEST RATE IN 18 YEARS TIGHTENS FUNDING CONDITIONS FOR ASX-LISTED JUNIOR MINERS
snippet: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised the cash rate by 25bp to 4.85% on November 3, the highest level since 2008, citing persistent services inflation and a still-tight labour market. For ASX-listed junior miners and developers, the hike increases the discount rate applied to future cash flows and raises the cost of exploration-stage debt and project financing.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $3,950 INTO ELECTION NIGHT — SAFE-HAVEN BID MATERIALISES AS POLLS CLOSE, BUT PAYROLLS FRIDAY LOOMS
snippet: Late Monday FXStreet analysis confirmed gold holding near $3,950 as US midterm polls began closing, with traders citing election-night uncertainty as a mild safe-haven catalyst. The article flags that the payrolls release on Friday — consensus 68,000 jobs — remains the bigger binary event for gold direction; a sub-40K print could catalyse the sharpest short-covering rally in juniors since 2022.
